name: SCGM Bhd
overview: SCGM Bhd 在2026年没有披露任何制造业务活动，营收为零。公司持续发布 Practice Note 16 规范化计划公告，并宣布被 uplift 为现金公司及板块重新分类。此外，公司宣派每股25仙特别股息。
overview_en: SCGM Bhd did not report any manufacturing business activity in 2026, with zero revenue. The company continued to issue Practice Note 16 regularization plan announcements and announced its upliftment as a cash company and reclassification of sector. Additionally, the company declared a special dividend of 25 sen per share.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司今年没有披露任何制造业务活动，主要围绕规范化计划和现金公司状态进行公告。
segments.note_en: The company did not disclose any manufacturing business activity this year, with announcements mainly focused on regularization plan and cash company status.

actions.text_en: The company announced its upliftment as a cash company and reclassification of sector.

actions.text: 公司宣派每股25.0仙的单层特别股息。
actions.text_en: The company declared a special dividend of 25.0 sen per share under single-tier system.

model_changes.title: SCGM BHD UPLIFTMENT AS A CASH COMPANY AND RECLASSIFICATION OF SECTOR
model_changes.text: 公司被 uplift 为现金公司并重新分类板块，表明其业务模式已从制造业务转变为现金公司。
model_changes.text_en: The company was uplifted as a cash company and reclassified its sector, indicating its business model has shifted from manufacturing to a cash company.
